title: Release package build on branch-2.13: dev/build.py shim delegates --package-type release|skinny to dev/build.sh
answers: How does the release workflow build the mlflow and mlflow-skinny packages for the 2.13 branch?
Where is the --package-type release or skinny option handled for the python release build?
Why does branch-2.13 use dev/build.sh instead of the newer dev/build.py build flow?
How do I add a new package variant to the 2.13 release build without changing shipped package contents?
body:
Path: dev/build.py:main and dev/build.py:parse_args handle the CLI invoked by the mlflow/releases python.yml workflow as `python dev/build.py --package-type <release|skinny>`. Release requests run `bash dev/build.sh`; skinny requests run `bash dev/build.sh --skinny`, which builds mlflow-skinny from pyproject.skinny.toml.
Rule: On branch-2.13, the package build is owned by dev/build.sh (pyproject.toml for mlflow, pyproject.skinny.toml for mlflow-skinny). dev/build.py only translates the workflow's --package-type into that shell call so the 2.13 build matches how 2.13.x shipped. Change package-building behaviour in dev/build.sh, not in the shim. The --sha flag is accepted for interface parity with the v3 dev/build.py and is ignored.
Constraints: Applies only to the branch-2.13 release line. Newer branches use their own dev/build.py implementation. dev/build.py is a dev/CI-only script and is not included in the shipped mlflow or mlflow-skinny wheels, so editing it does not change released package contents.
applies: branch-2.13 release tooling: dev/build.py as the workflow entry point and its delegation to dev/build.sh.

search: On branch-2.13, dev/build.py acts as a CLI shim that translates --package-type release and --package-type skinny into executions of dev/build.sh or dev/build.sh --skinny. Package building is owned by dev/build.sh using pyproject.toml for standard packages and pyproject.skinny.toml for skinny packages. The --sha flag is accepted and ignored for interface parity, and modifications should be made in dev/build.sh rather than the shim. This script is CI-only, excluded from shipped wheels, and applies exclusively to the branch-2.13 release line.
